summary: Implement a generator over a circular array starting at a given index. Each next(jump) moves by the signed jump, wraps modulo the length, and yields the element at the new position.
inputFormat: An array and a starting index; next(jump) takes a signed integer jump.
outputFormat: Generator results (the current element) with wrapping.
